notes.title: Patch 2 Released
notes.content:
Patch 2 has been released.  Thank you to everyone for reporting bugs and suggesting helpful features, and as always thank you so much for your support.

This patch fixes the following issues:
 - Fixed skills that cast on chests.
 - Fixed 'Floor is made of lava' achievement.
 - Fixed end of level portal interaction bug.
 - FIxed rare bug where creatures remain in world after death.

notes.title: First Patch is Up.
notes.content:
First, I want to thank you all for your support and your help with reporting bugs. We have been listening and correcting bugs and adding some requested features.

This patch includes:
 - Fixed compatibility with 32-bit Windows.
 - Fixed anti-aliasing slider.
 - Fixed texture quality bug on Windows.
 - Improved performance.
 - Corrected rare instance where 2 graphical panels share the same space.

ADDED FEATURE:
Hotkeys for skill activation and inventory. They are as follows:

Key bindings:

1 - Activates left most card
1 while card is activated - make selected card larger

2 - Activates center card
2 while card is activated - make selected card larger

3 - Activates right hand card
3 while card is activated - make selected card larger

4(or i) - Open inventory
4 (or i) again while inventory is open - close inventory

Space - Ends turn.

Esc - Open in game menu. Also closes inventory or menu when it’s open.


Thanks to Jack Dandy for suggestions.


FYI there are also camera controlling hotkeys and they are as follows:
Q,E - Rotate Camera
W,A,S,D - Pan Camera


Once again, I'd like to thank you so much for your support and please keep the comments and reports coming.
